annotations.text:
Seven directions, all rebuilt on the canonical Lens v3 kit.

Every page uses the real kit classes, the six explainer widgets, and the canonical logo. Recall is now ReExam: $600 a month flat, no contract, guarantee quoted exactly.

Start with The Catalogue. It is the direction you picked first, rebuilt.

Two things still need you:

1. Whether to name incumbent vendors on a public page. Prototypes use one quote, by role and date, no vendor in a headline.

2. Gabe: permission to name the practice, and an actual endorsement. The quotes here are real but they are thanks for fixes, not testimonials.
